name: Chaldeans
overview: The Chaldeans, often identified as learned and wise men of the East, are depicted in Scripture as skilled in astrology, magic, and interpretation of dreams, serving prominently in the Babylonian court (Daniel 1:4; 2:2; 4:7; 5:7). Despite their reputed wisdom, the Lord pronounces judgment upon them and the princes of Babylon, highlighting their ultimate inability to stand against God's sovereign will (Jeremiah 50:35). This underscores the biblical truth that human wisdom, even that associated with the Chaldeans, is insufficient apart from divine revelation.
